resources.string: Restore \"%1$s\"? The current world and configs contained in this backup are first moved to .mcmanager/restore-old-…, so you can undo this by hand.
Delete backup \"%1$s\"? This cannot be undone.
Restore is disabled while the server is running. Stop it first. Creating a backup while running is safe (the world is saved first).
Manual and imported backups are never deleted automatically. Android may delay scheduled work to save battery.
Connected via mobile data. Friends on the same Wi-Fi cannot reach this phone; if you share a hotspot, they use the hotspot address.
Address for players on the same network
No local address found. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn on the hotspot.
Address for players on your hotspot
On mobile data, or when this phone is the hotspot, friends who join your hotspot use the hotspot address (usually 192.168.x.x).
Changes the port in the app and in server.properties.
Stop the server to change the port.
Asks your router to open the server port automatically (best latency, no extra hop). Works only if the router has UPnP enabled and your ISP gives you a real public IP.
Remove forward when the server stops
No UPnP router answered. Enable UPnP in the router settings or forward the port manually.
Your ISP uses CGNAT (or the router is behind another router), so port forwarding cannot work. Use playit.gg below.
Router has a public address. Players can join using the address below.
Could not read the router address, so CGNAT cannot be ruled out. If friends cannot join, use playit.gg.

A phone cannot reliably test its own public address (the router often does not loop traffic back, called hairpin NAT). Ask a friend on another network to join with the address shown. No fake test is offered.
No global IPv6 address on this connection.
Players must also have IPv6. Your router\'s IPv6 firewall may block incoming connections; you may need to allow the port there.
Works behind CGNAT. After claiming the agent, create a Minecraft Java tunnel on playit.gg pointing to 127.0.0.1:%1$d. Players connect to the address playit gives you.
Downloads the official playit agent. Not yet tested on a device.
Open the claim page to link this phone to your playit.gg account.
Tunnel address not detected in the agent output. Copy it from your playit.gg dashboard.
Latency: traffic takes one extra hop through the nearest playit server.
Alternative tunnel. TCP endpoints require an ngrok account with a verified payment card. Paste your authtoken from the ngrok dashboard.
Downloads the official ngrok agent. Not yet tested on a device.
Free-tier latency depends on the region; choose India (in) if you are in India.
Stop tunnels when all servers stop
Waiting for you to claim the agent
Takes effect after a server restart.
Best to worst: direct UPnP/port-forward, then IPv6, then playit.gg (nearest region), then ngrok.
Keep the phone on 5 GHz Wi-Fi, close to the router, and charging.
While a server runs, the app holds a low-latency Wi-Fi lock.
Lower view-distance helps most on a phone.
If you run an external tunnel (Playit on PC/router, Cloudflare, or a reverse proxy), set your public hostname:port here to display it across the app.
Notice: Android lacks /etc/resolv.conf required by the musl Playit binary for DNS. If claiming hangs, run Playit on a PC/router or paste an existing secret key below.
